senses.gloss:
ष्णिह् (ऌ ऊ) r. 4th cl. (स्निह्यति)
 1. To bear affection to, to love, to
regard, to be kind to or pleased with.
 2. To be sticky.
 3. To be
kind to; (this root and all its derivatives govern the loc. of
the person or thing for whom or which affection is or felt. r. 10th
cl. (स्नेहयति-ते) To be unctuous, to be bland or greasy.
